place.name: Lagos, Portugal
place.description: Lagos (pronounced [ˈlaɣuʃ] ; Proto-Celtic: *Lacobriga) is a city and municipality in the Barlavento region of the Algarve, southern Portugal, situated at the mouth of the Bensafrim River along the Atlantic Ocean. As of the March 2021 census, the municipality had a population of 33,494 across an area of 212.99 km².
